question: How is the four-path junction located in the body?
premises: A four-path junction is recognized through dissolution in the Śakti-bearing principle.
This is held to occur right there.
In the body it is established at the region ending in nose, palate, and aperture.
inference: The four-path junction is both a subtle dissolution point and a bodily locus in the upper channels.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical mapping of nāsānta-tālu-randhra is interpretive.
plain_english: They hold that the four-path junction arises there itself by dissolution in the Śakti-bearing principle, and in this body it is established in the region of the nose, palate, and aperture.
